task_completion.description: The Weasis medical viewer application is open and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is active, showing the DICOM viewer interface.

task_completion.description: DICOM image content is loaded into the viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Medical imaging (e.g., X-ray, CT, or MRI) is visible within the main viewing area.

task_completion.description: The agent interacts with the layout selection tool or menu.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layout grid selector or a menu showing grid options (e.g., 1x1, 1x2, 2x2) is clicked or highlighted.

task_completion.description: The layout is changed to a 1 row x 2 columns (side-by-side) configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewer workspace is divided into exactly two vertical panels side-by-side.

task_completion.description: DICOM image content is displayed in both panels of the split view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Both the left and right panels contain DICOM image data, not empty black space.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the configured layout to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file save dialog or a terminal command confirms the export to ~/DICOM/exports/split_view.png.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to change the layout rather than just manipulating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the layout icons or menu items in the Weasis interface.

integrity.description: The split view is a result of application state, not a static image opened in a different viewer.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Weasis UI elements (toolbars, thumbnails, patient info) are visible around the split-view panels.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing image to split_view.png.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step transition from a single view to a split view within the application.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The final output must be a PNG file located at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/split_view.png. The layout must be exactly 1 row by 2 columns. The images used are real DICOM samples from Rubo Medical.
